$comment: Single source of truth for the contact-proxy worker's brand routing AND the smoke test's brand list. Both worker (src/index.ts) and smoke (scripts/smoke.mjs) import this file directly. Adding a new child brand: add an entry to `brands` and redeploy the worker — smoke picks it up automatically. Convention for child-brand sites without their own verified Emailit domain: `from: '<Brand> via GoMKS <hello@gomks.com>'`, `to: 'leads@gomks.com'`. See memory/emailit_domain_verification.md.
